description: Real-time Chart Tip Updates: Extend the streaming infrastructure to update the most recent candle/point of the chart in real-time when streaming is active.
principles: Build on Feature 12 - reuse StreamingService, don't reinvent
Minimal scope - only update the tip, not historical data
Clean lifecycle - proper subscribe/unsubscribe on ticker change and unmount
Graceful degradation - works fine when streaming disabled or unavailable
Performance first - avoid flicker, throttle if needed

userStories.title: Add multi-listener support to StreamingService
acceptanceCriteria: Add add_quote_listener(callback) method to StreamingService
Add remove_quote_listener(callback) method to StreamingService
Maintain internal list of quote listeners
Invoke all registered listeners when quote arrives
Backward compatible: on_quote param in start() registers as first listener
remove_quote_listener is no-op if callback not found (no error)
Test: multiple listeners all receive quotes
Test: removing listener stops it from receiving quotes
Test: backward compatibility with existing start(on_quote=...) usage
userStories.notes: Simple extension to existing StreamingService. Change _on_quote from single callback to list of callbacks.

userStories.title: ChartPanel streaming integration
acceptanceCriteria: ChartPanel registers quote listener with StreamingService when chart loads
ChartPanel subscribes to current ticker symbol
ChartPanel unsubscribes from previous ticker when switching
ChartPanel removes listener and unsubscribes on unmount
Quote listener filters to only process matching ticker
Candlestick: update last candle close price from streaming price
Candlestick: update last candle high if streaming day_high exceeds current
Candlestick: update last candle low if streaming day_low below current
Candlestick: update last candle volume from streaming volume (data.volumes[-1] - volume bars re-render automatically)
Braille/Line: update last price point from streaming price
Re-render chart after tip update (lightweight, no data fetch)
Recalculate stats row with updated tip data
No subscription when streaming globally disabled
No errors when streaming unavailable or fails
Test: tip updates in candlestick mode
Test: tip updates in braille mode
Test: cleanup on unmount
Test: cleanup on ticker switch
userStories.notes: ChartPanel manages its own streaming lifecycle. Open price comes from historical data (unchanged). Symbol filtering happens in the listener callback.

technicalNotes.openPrice: StreamingQuote doesn't include open. Historical data provides correct open for the period.
technicalNotes.symbolFiltering: ChartPanel listener receives all quotes, filters by self._current_ticker.
technicalNotes.coexistence: WatchlistPanel and ChartPanel can subscribe to same symbol independently.
technicalNotes.throttling: Start without throttling. Add if flicker observed (follow-up optimization).
